findings.location: ...35,000 feet over the sub-Saharan desert land of Chad and Niger...
findings.source_quote: The stark contrast between the landscape described in the previous paragraphs and the parched desert land hurrying by six miles below me is nearly beyond my comprehension.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove or mark the added metric conversion as an editorial note, or include it inline in parentheses only if the publisher's style requires unit conversions. Suggested phrasing preserving original meaning: keep the original wording and if conversion is required by house style, render as “six miles below me (≈9.7 km)”.
findings.translation_quote: 앞 문단에서 묘사한 풍경과 아래 6마일(약 9.7km) 아래로 급히 지나가는 메마른 사막 지대 사이의 현저한 대조는 거의 이해하기 어려울 지경입니다.

findings.source_quote: They fast from food and water every day from dawn to dusk, even though daytime temperatures exceed 110 degrees.
findings.suggested_fix: Clarify the temperature unit only if required by house style. To preserve the source text, either leave as in the original or state the unit explicitly: “...temperatures exceed 110 degrees (Fahrenheit).”
